title: At the doctor's
description: Describe symptoms and understand what the doctor says.

explanation.summary: When you are ill you need to say what hurts and how long it has been happening. Spanish has a verb for pain that works like gustar, and the imperfect is the tense for a symptom that was there for a while rather than a single finished accident.

sections.heading: Where it hurts
sections.body: The verb doler works like gustar: the part of the body comes first and the verb agrees with it. You say me duele la cabeza, me duelen las piernas, me duele la espalda. The verb and the body part are enough; there is no extra word for the person who hurts.

examples.es: Me duele la cabeza desde ayer.
examples.en: My head has hurt since yesterday.

examples.es: Me duelen los pies después de trabajar.

sections.heading: The doctor and the diagnosis
sections.body: The doctor asks the questions and gives you el diagnóstico: una fractura, una infección, un esguince. An injury that broke a bone is una fractura, and the place where two bones meet is la articulación. The soft parts that move the bones are los músculos, and a strain in one of them is un esguince.

examples.es: El diagnóstico fue una fractura en la pierna.
examples.en: The diagnosis was a fracture in the leg.

examples.es: El dolor viene de la articulación.
examples.en: The pain comes from the joint.

sections.heading: The medicine and the treatment
sections.body: The treatment is el tratamiento, and it can be a pill (la cápsula), a syrup (el jarabe) or a cream (la pomada). The general word for what the doctor gives you is el tratamiento, and the symptom you describe is el síntoma. Say how long you have had it: lo tengo desde hace tres días.

examples.es: Toma el jarabe tres veces al día.
examples.en: Take the syrup three times a day.

exercises.prompt: Pair each word with its translation.
exercises.note: For symptoms that lasted: me dolía la cabeza, tenía fiebre, no podía dormir.

exercises.prompt: Pick the Spanish word for “the symptom”.
exercises.note: Masculine: el síntoma. What the doctor asks you about.
